latestVersion.changelog: Initial ClawHub release. 12 read-only, keyless verbs over live Asian-priced football & basketball: today, digest, events, match, preview, line, fair, scan, compare (judge a prediction-market price vs the sharp de-vigged fair line), scoreprob, convert, result. One concise line per answer. Talks only to api.infersports.dev; offline-verifiable via INFERSPORTS_MOCK=1; MIT.
